scope: All 114 original shadcn PNGs individually viewed, including duplicates; current review is bound to the retained Linux snapshot, not the current entire repository.

reference.projectExtension: Light unchecked thumb has a 1px boundary; border-box keeps external geometry. This is documented project desktop adaptation, not an upstream fix.

hostWorkbench.explanation: The Windows host cache is a different workbench build boundary. Its index/404/manifest differ and 16 Linux hash-named workbench files are absent. Review binds the original stable Linux artifact fingerprint and native attachments, not these host cache entries. No rebuild or evidence rewrite was performed.

observedConclusions: Light neutral off track remains distinguishable by the documented thin thumb boundary; checked black/white and dark inverse pairs are clear.
All three visual sizes show coherent geometry and uncut keyboard focus rings; medium Firefox/WebKit subsets preserve the observed layout.
Disabled-selected screenshots consistently show on, including medium across all engines, and error off/on colors preserve their visible state.
Hover/pressed can have identical bytes to the neutral default or checked state; all duplicates were individually viewed, and shadcn does not introduce the MD3 halo or variable-thumb-size protocol.
Narrow/English text wraps; RTL reverses alignment and thumb direction while retaining on meaning; brand and forced-colors retain readable visible structure.
Two real-zoom PNGs show complete visible track focus and text at 200%; they cover the visible viewport only.

geometryAndHitSeparation.visualOnly: PNG review supports visible track/thumb/focus/text bounds, not invisible hit extent.
geometryAndHitSeparation.nativeEvidence: The existing Chromium environment and real-zoom cases measured actual pseudo-element CDP box models and clicked/tapped true edge points, then asserted aria-checked and output. These native passed assertions are separate evidence, not inferred from PNG appearance.
geometryAndHitSeparation.crossEngineLimit: Firefox/WebKit core screenshots and public geometry do not imply the Chromium pseudo-element CDP edge test was run in those engines.

limits: No new browser, capture, build, source modification, baseline establishment/update, two-run comparison or verified/lifecycle change.
Inventory six PNGs remain default viewport evidence, not named static baseline approval.
Images do not prove reduced-motion timing, screen-reader behavior, contrast ratios or all touch targets.
The two native zoom videos are retained evidence; this review viewed PNGs and did not claim full video motion review.
No iframe/Shadow DOM or all-provider-boundary acceptance is inferred from these inline Switch images.

Line/Text/Number demos may now differ elsewhere in the workspace. Only Switch authored source and published ESM/CSS hashes were rechecked against capture; no current whole-worktree identity is asserted.

baselinePolicy.followup: Coordinated approval/native baseline creation and two consecutive ordinary canonical comparisons remain required.
